questions.stem: 模擬聯合國（Model United Nations）的會議常由大學社團舉辦，許多英文老師鼓勵學生參加。
questions.answer: Model United Nations conferences are often organized by university clubs, and many English teachers encourage students to take part.
accepted_answers: Model United Nations conferences are often held by college clubs, and many English teachers encourage their students to participate.
Conferences of Model United Nations are often hosted by university clubs, and many English teachers encourage students to join them.

patterns: 動詞＋受詞＋不定詞（encourage + O + to VR）

questions.stem: 和一般英文課相比，這類會議對那些想當外交官的人更有幫助。
questions.answer: Compared with regular English classes, such conferences are more helpful to those who want to become diplomats.
accepted_answers: Compared to ordinary English classes, this kind of conference is more helpful for those who hope to be diplomats.
Compared with general English lessons, these conferences are more useful to those who want to work as diplomats.

1.explanation_zh: 「會議常由大學社團舉辦」主詞是會議，會議是被舉辦的，用被動語態 are often organized by university clubs（be + p.p. + by）。「鼓勵學生參加」是 encourage + 受詞 + to VR：encourage students to take part（participate 要接 in 才能接受詞）。兩個完整子句用 and 連接。
evidence: 會議常由大學社團舉辦
1.strategy_zh: 看到「由…舉辦／製作」先想被動 be + p.p. + by；encourage 後面先接人，再接 to VR。
hints: 切成四段：模擬聯合國（Model United Nations）的會議／常由大學社團舉辦／許多英文老師鼓勵學生／參加
標的詞彙：conference（會議，L4）、organize（舉辦，L3）、university（大學，L2）、club（社團，L1）、teacher（老師，L1）、encourage（鼓勵，L2）、take part（參加）
句型框架：S + are often + p.p. + by …, and S + encourage + O + to VR

2.explanation_zh: 「和一般英文課相比」用 Compared with regular English classes 放句首（過去分詞 compared）。「那些想當外交官的人」是 those who want to become diplomats，those 後面接 who 子句，動詞用複數 want。「這類會議」寫 such conferences（複數，動詞用 are）；「更有幫助」是比較級 more helpful（helpful 是形容詞，不要寫成 more help），整句：such conferences are more helpful to those who …。
evidence: 對那些想當外交官的人更有幫助
2.strategy_zh: 「和 A 相比，B 比較…」用 Compared with A, B + be + 比較級；「那些…的人」用 those who + V。
hints: 切成四段：和一般英文課相比／這類會議／對那些想當外交官的人／更有幫助
標的詞彙：compare（比較，L2）、regular（一般的，L2）、class（課，L1）、conference（會議，L4）、helpful（有幫助的，L1）、diplomat（外交官，L4）
句型框架：Compared with + N, S + be + more + adj. + to + those who + V …

1.restructuring_zh: 「會議常由大學社團舉辦」主詞「會議」是被舉辦的一方，英文改成被動語態 are often organized by university clubs。
1.notes_zh: 「模擬聯合國的會議」Model United Nations／Model UN conferences（或 meetings、events）都可以；「舉辦」organized、held、hosted、run 都給分，一定要用被動 are … by；「大學社團」university clubs、college clubs、student clubs at universities 都可以；兩個子句之間用 and 連接（或分成兩句）；「鼓勵學生參加」encourage (their) students to take part／participate／join／attend (them)。

2.restructuring_zh: 「那些想當外交官的人」英文用 those who want to become diplomats：先寫 those，再用 who 子句放在後面說明是哪些人。
2.notes_zh: 「和…相比」Compared with／to、In comparison with 都可以，「一般的」regular、ordinary、general、normal 都給分，classes／lessons 都可以；「這類會議」such conferences、these conferences、this kind of conference 都可以（複數主詞動詞用 are，單數 this kind of conference 用 is），conferences 也可寫 meetings；「那些想當外交官的人」本句練的是 those who …（前面用 for 或 to 都可以），寫成 people who … 也是用關係代名詞 who 引導的形容詞子句，同樣給分；「想當」want／hope／wish to become／be、want to work as 都可以；「更有幫助」more helpful／useful。

1.translation: Model United Nations conferences are often held by college clubs, and many English teachers encourage students to take part in them.
1.explanation_zh: 「會議常由大學社團舉辦」是被動，用 are often held by（也可 organized by）；後半句換主詞，用 and 連接；「鼓勵學生參加」用 encourage + 受詞 + to V，「參加」用 take part in（也可 participate in / attend），them 指這些會議。

2.translation: Compared with regular English classes, such conferences are more helpful to those who want to become diplomats.
2.explanation_zh: 「和…相比」用過去分詞片語 Compared with …；「更有幫助」用比較級 more helpful；「那些想當外交官的人」用 those who want to become diplomats（who 關係子句）。

1.translation: Model United Nations conferences are often organized by university clubs, and many English teachers encourage students to take part in them.
1.explanation_zh: 「模擬聯合國的會議」用 Model United Nations conferences；「常由大學社團舉辦」用被動語態 are often organized by；「鼓勵學生參加」用 encourage students to take part in them；兩個分句用 and 連接。

2.translation: Compared with regular English classes, this kind of conference is more helpful to those who want to become diplomats.
2.explanation_zh: 「和一般英文課相比」用 Compared with 片語；「這類會議」用 this kind of conference（單數，動詞 is）；「更有幫助」用 more helpful；「那些想當外交官的人」用 those who want to become diplomats。
